highlights: UGreen Tire Inflator Portable Cordless Electric Air Pump 150PSI Auto-Off Tire Pump with LED Light Digital Gauge for Accurate Pressure Readings for Cars, Motorcycles, Balls, All Bicycles

[5 INFLATION MODES] This portable air compressor has 5 preset inflation modes: free mode(3-150psi), ball mode(4-16psi, default 8psi), bicycle mode(30-65psi, default 45psi), motorcycle mode(1.8-3.0bar, default 2.4bar), car (1.8) -3.5 bar, default 2.5 bar). Car tire inflator supports automatic detection of the air pressure of the equipment and automatic shut-off function to prevent excessive inflation.

[Multifunctional] Mini portable electric pump itself is a Schrader valve, Presta valve adapter, inflation needle, air nozzle are provided. Suitable for cars, motorcycles, bicycles, scooters, scooters, basketball, football, volleyball, etc. This electric inflator is a good helper for outdoor enthusiasts, it is ideal for camping, hiking, cycling, road trip, etc.

[Fast Inflating] Professional wireless inflation device, built-in pure copper DC motor, low resistance, accelerate faster and higher efficiency: less than 20s to fill basketball or football, 120s for 165/70 R13 2.0~2.5 bar car tires. 2*2500mAh built-in battery, the fully charged electric tire inflator can charge about 80 basketballs, 15 bicycle tires, 8 motorcycle tires, 12 car tires (165/70 R13) and 3 car tires (195/65 R15).

[Compact and Convenient] The mini electric tyre inflator weighs only 486g and measures 135*78*48mm, small and lightweight, can be stored in any small corner of the car, perfect for use on the go. Built-in battery, electric pump is equipped with a USB-C charging port and comes with a charging cable. You can connect it to your car's cigarette lighter charger to charge it at any time.

[LCD Display & LED Lamp] HD digital screen gives you ease of use and visual richness, it clearly shows 3 different units (PSI/KPA/Bar) and can change 5 kinds of inflation modes with one button. An independent button can control the flashlight, provide you with convenient emergency lighting at night. There are also 3 light effects: Lighting/SOS/Warning.
